scope: Retire post-NGE GCW rank ability skills, buffs, all direct combat-action handlers, the direct aura effect add writer, and player aura runtime while preserving authenticated Publish 14.1 faction rank, standing, recruiters, titles/badges, retained battle content, remove-side cleanup, and non-player compatibility.

findings: Publish 14.1 faction rank is persisted independently and promoted through authored faction-point costs; it is not an NGE profession or expertise reward tree.
The inherited pvp_imperial_* and pvp_rebel_* skill rows grant six later GCW combat ability tiers per faction, including an expertise-protection aura and airstrike.
Faction rank, badges/titles, recruiters, bases, battles, quests, zones, and compatibility data can remain active without granting those later combat abilities.

The retained 12 command rows fan into 20 command/effect handlers, and the aura controller can reschedule itself independently of skill grants; both runtime surfaces require player-only fail-closed gates in addition to persisted-skill cleanup.

Two retained aura effect mappings route both faction self-buffs through pvpAuraBuffSelfAddBuffHandler. Generic admission and all controller callbacks were already player-inert, but this direct add-side handler could still attach the later aura controller before those downstream guards ran. It now performs central player reward cleanup and returns before attachment; the remove-side handler remains available for cleanup and non-player behavior is unchanged.
